info.name: Rental Manager API Tests
info.description:
Self-contained API tests organized by endpoint. Each test creates its own prerequisites via pre-request scripts. Run with `npm run test:api` or import into Postman GUI.

Environment variables required: `base_url`, `admin_token`, `customer_token`, `TEST_IMAGE_UPLOAD_PATH`.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Profile endpoints. All authenticated users can access these.
